problems: The fire barely shows. The flame tongues are short, stand straight up and are hidden under the pot base, so they read as a row of small white dots with no orange, though 'orange fire' is a hero color. Raise the grate so there is a visible gap between burner and pot, and make the tongues taller and tilted outward so their orange tips show around the pot's base.
The burner sits almost on the stove top under a low grate, which hides the flame ring. Lift the grate and pot a little so the burner and its flame ring read at once.

The grate stands far too high. The pot sits about a third of its height above the burner, like a pot on a side table instead of on a stove grate, and the flames stop well short of the pot's bottom. A real grate holds the pot just above the flame.

The fire is too small and too pale to read as the card's bright fire. The tongues are small white and yellow drops in a band near the burner. The orange tips are not visible, and no flame reaches up to the pot's base.
The grate legs are tall and thin, so the stand reads as a separate trivet instead of part of the stove top.
